instruction: Cinematic medium full shot of an indoor sports gymnasium with a polished wooden floor. In the center of the frame, the man with an afro (R1) in a white t-shirt and grey sweatpants stands behind the young girl in a pink tracksuit (R5). The young girl (R5) performs a handstand on the floor, her legs extended straight up into the air. The man (R1) holds her ankles firmly with both hands to stabilize her balance. Soft natural light illuminates the scene from the side, casting gentle shadows on the warm wooden floor, with a blurred background.
